subject: Confirmation requested on the Section 31 50 00 setback requirement for the excavation

messages.text: At Placement Zone 2, the geotechnical report doesn't clearly speak to the Section 31 50 00 setback requirement for the excavation shoring near the property line -- can the civil inspector sign off on it as shown? This is becoming more pressing as backfill work approaches. A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
